title: Clicks, comments, consequences: Are content creators’ socio-structural and platform characteristics shaping the exposure to negative sentiment, offensive language, and hate speech on YouTube?
benchmark_measurement: The study measured whether the religious affiliation of a YouTube content creator shapes their exposure to negative sentiment, offensive language, and hate speech in video comments.
findings: The study found no significant evidence that the religious affiliation of a content creator is associated with their exposure to negative sentiment, offensive language, or hate speech on YouTube.
